title: Coast Guard Rescue Crew Returns to Base
description:
Coast Guard rescue crew returns to base

A rescue crew aboard an Air Station Clearwater, Fla., HC-130 Hercules aircraft returns to base after finding nine missing boaters of the coast of Honduras on Wednesday, July 3, 2013. After the boaters were spotted, the aircrew directed members of the Joint Task Force Bravo's Army UH-60 helicopter crew to hoist the survivors. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Michael De Nyse.
